description: This file defines the class 'BuzzLikeOnShareDecorator', which provides a decorator pattern implementation for the 'BuzzLikeOnShare' entity, including methods to set related employee and share by their IDs and to retrieve formatted date/time information of when the like occurred.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShareDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the BuzzLikeOnShare entity that adds helper methods to set relationships and format date/time data.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Returns the BuzzLikeOnShare entity instance associated with this decorator.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee for the BuzzLikeOnShare entity based on employee number.

methods.name: setShareByShareId
methods.description: Sets the BuzzShare for the BuzzLikeOnShare entity based on share ID.

methods.name: getLikedAtDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the like was made, formatted as a string.

methods.name: getLikedAtTime
methods.description: Returns the time when the like was made, formatted as a string.
